messages:
mira: starting intake for skyhook-8b bring-up. goal: test int8 -> int4 quant path, validate quality vs current hosted baseline, and run hosted + dedicated canary. posting initial checklist and rough schedule. doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/skyhook-intake :eyes:

sam: thanks — which deploy modes we want in first canary? hosted only or also a tiny dedicated pool?

mira: hosted 1% initially. parallel small dedicated canary (2 GPUs) for stress tests and p95 SLA. plan: int8 first (baseline ppl/latency), then try int4 if quality holds. fallback to fp16 model variant.

jules: for evals we should do: latency (p50/p95), token-efficiency, rouge/qa F1 on our prompt set, hallucination checks (factbench), and a safety filter smoke. also do A/B eval against baseline-prod for 5k samples.

mira: acceptance criteria quick list:
- quality delta <= 1.5% relative F1 drop vs baseline-prod on priority eval set
- hallucination rate not increase > 0.5% absolute
- p95 latency hosted <= 1.5x baseline-prod
- no OOMs on dedicated canary after warmup
- observability hooks (traces, token cost per request) present

harper: infra notes: dedicated canary uses older A10G pool in eu-west for now. int4 runs look memory-friendly but KV cache alignment might cause spikes. need warmup script and memory probe. recommend a rolling warmup: 5k synthetic prefixes with increasing seq len.

jules: adding the rollout config we talked about (prototype):
```
{
  "routes": [
    {"name":"hosted-skyhook-int8","split":0.01,"fallback":"hosted-skyhook-fp16"},
    {"name":"dedicated-skyhook-int8-canary","pool":"eu-west-a10g","instances":2,"traffic":"test-only"}
  ],
  "monitoring": ["p95_latency","model_quality_delta","oom_count","token_cost_per_request"],
  "auto-fallback": {"on":"oom_count>0","action":"route-to:hosted-skyhook-fp16"}
}
```

sam: smoke tests we need before sending live traffic:
- inference correctness on 200 control prompts (sanity)
- churn test: 1k concurrent short reqs to verify batching behavior
- KV cache hit ratio check after 10k requests
- end-to-end tracing tags present

ops-bot: Reminder: canary deployments must include alerting thresholds in console. Required alerts: p95 latency > 2s, error rate > 0.5%, oom_count > 0. Escalation: @harper -> @sam -> oncall. :bell:

eva: schedule-wise: canary smoke window = 48h after deploy, followed by 72h monitored ramp if green. PM decision gate at end of smoke with QA signoff + infra green. please add ownership for each checklist item.

mira: owners assigned:
- eval harness + A/B: jules
- perf and warmup scripts: harper + sam
- rollout config + infra: sam
- alerting + dashboards: jules
- PM gate + user-facing risk comms: eva

mira: next steps: jules to kick off eval run today, harper to provide warmup script by EOD, sam will stage the dedicated canary tomorrow morning. target smoke deploy Thu 08:00 UTC. tagging this thread #skyhook-intake :rocket:

sam: noted. will post dedicated pool sizing and preflight checklist in a follow-up here.

jules: starting A/B now, will post preliminary numbers in ~6h. :mag_right:

mira: thanks team — keep comms lightweight here, escalate to incidents/ if anything trips the auto-fallback. closing initial intake, will re-open thread with canary timestamps. :thumbsup:
